comment: Coverage is defined as the proportion of reference elements realised. This gives equal weight to minor and critical elements and can be inflated by modelling many low-level elements.

anchor.note: p.86 l.Lines 1224-1230 read as the printed page; section 3.7.5 agrees

public.text: Coverage is defined as the proportion of reference elements realised. This gives equal weight to minor and critical elements and can be inflated by modelling many low-level elements.
public.suggestedRevision: Report coverage by layer, capability, component, criticality, and health goal. Avoid a single undifferentiated percentage as the principal adoption measure.
